email.body1:
Art, saw Aurora land the McLane deal and triple the driverless network to 10 routes.

Scaling commercial operations that fast usually means more in-market shippers and fleets in play than BD can personally cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Aurora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Art, quick follow-up for Aurora.

As the network expands across the Sun Belt, the question is how many meetings BD needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of that growth, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Aurora needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Art, last bit of proof for Aurora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Aurora's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Art, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters during fast expansion, and I know scaling a driverless network is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Aurora either way.
